capture_schedule.phase_definition: optimizer-step index in a predeclared 256-step, step-scheduled run; never wall-clock progress

claim_scope.future_real_trace: Shadow-mode empirical diagnostic. Training parameters must be updated by the unchanged pinned baseline, never by the P20 output.
claim_scope.global_claim_boundary: Sampled gradients cannot prove global fidelity, passivity, stability, or neural-network convergence.
claim_scope.synthetic_runner: Deterministic CPU infrastructure diagnostic only; it contains no model, dataset, backward pass, accelerator, or real gradient.
claim_scope.theorem_gate: No external GPU trace may run until the P21 analytic generator, independent reconstruction, and boundary/negative witnesses pass.

external_execution_blockers: no NanoGPT or Modded-NanoGPT source tree is present
no trainer revision or instrumentation patch is pinned
no dataset, tokenizer, checkpoint, or real-gradient trace is present
the local host has no CUDA or MPS device
vanilla GPT-2 fused-QKV shape 768x2304 is not in P20's certified shape table

hard.intended_muon_matrix_coverage_count_and_: 100%; otherwise the trace is explicitly partial

p16_p18_reused.annulus_output_to_aspect_scaled_upstream: 1/4 <= ||T||_F/||C||_F <= 8, with at least one observation in every phase

metric_semantics.activation: Any P20 action other than bitwise pass-through, including radial clip, half fallback, zero singleton handling when changed, or the proposed P21 dead-zone-zero wrapper.
metric_semantics.aspect_order: C = fl_candidate_dtype(sqrt(max(1,rows/columns))*raw_candidate) is formed before orientation and before P20.
metric_semantics.best_scalar_departure: sqrt(max(0,||T||^2-<S,T>^2/||S||^2))/||T||; zero target gives 0 and zero signal with nonzero target gives 1.
metric_semantics.candidate_output_cosine: <C,T>/(||C|| ||T||); undefined if either norm is zero.
metric_semantics.effective_gain: eta*||T||_F/||S||_F, reported for eta=1/120 and eta=1/83.
metric_semantics.missing_values: Only mathematically undefined zero-denominator ratios are None. Nonfinite values are failures and are never silently removed.
metric_semantics.nearest_rank_quantile: Sort finite nonmissing values and return x[ceil(p*n)-1].
metric_semantics.relative_correction: ||T-C||_F/||C||_F; undefined for C=0 and explicitly classified as both-zero or nonzero-over-zero.
metric_semantics.zero_ratio_policy: A zero denominator yields no numeric ratio. Both-zero and nonzero-over-zero are recorded separately; neither is inserted into a quantile.

observer_contract.candidate_source: The real study must copy the actual stored backend candidate before aspect scaling; CPU recomputation is permitted only in tests and the synthetic diagnostic.
observer_contract.input: contiguous stored CPU copy of S and the actual pre-aspect candidate, each FP32 or BF16
observer_contract.noninterference: The observer clones inputs and never returns an update to the baseline optimizer. A trace-on/off bitwise model, optimizer-state, loss, and RNG regression is required before real acquisition.
observer_contract.orientation: If only the reversed shape is P20-certified, transpose S and C together, make a bit-preserving contiguous copy, shield, then transpose the output back.
observer_contract.output: P20 FP32 result and diagnostic record; the output is never applied during shadow tracing.
observer_contract.subnormal_policy: If P20 cannot represent a positive-sector output for an all-subnormal S, the proposed P21 wrapper records zero plus the absolute disturbance bound ||S||_F/2. This is not a successful P20 sector call.

predeclared_real_run.capture_selection: all intended Muon hidden-matrix parameters at every capture step; no post-hoc layer or shape selection
predeclared_real_run.distributed_scope: single device only for the first trace; distributed reductions are deferred
predeclared_real_run.initialization: from scratch unless a checkpoint and its SHA-256 are frozen before the run

data: train and validation binary SHA-256 values
tokenizer name/revision/vocabulary and merges SHA-256 values
hardware: GPU names, UUIDs, count, compute capabilities, and VRAM
optimizer: all parameter groups and named parameter-to-group map
beta, learning-rate schedule, weight decay, aspect formula, epsilon, Jordan coefficients and iteration count
gradient accumulation and candidate/signal/output cast order
repository: OptimizationML SHA, branch, dirty state, source snapshot, protocol SHA-256, and lockfile SHA-256
trainer repository URL, exact revision, dirty state, and instrumentation patch SHA-256
KellerJordan/Muon revision, audited muon.py SHA-256, and license
run: full model config and named parameter/shape/numel inventory
Python, NumPy, Torch CPU/CUDA seeds and dataloader seed
batch size, sequence length, gradient accumulation, token count, and exact capture steps
checkpoint initialization method and SHA-256 when applicable
software: PyTorch version, build Git SHA, and torch.__config__
CUDA driver/runtime/toolkit, cuDNN, NCCL, and Triton versions
autocast dtype, TF32, matmul precision, deterministic and compile flags
